facts.what: Gage 自述童年：父亲像办非法斗狗一样把他关起来逼他与人搏斗求生，甚至逼他对 Sam 下手；父亲的虐童犯罪圈被端掉后他被带走。
facts.anchor: He even forced me to beat… I can’t talk about what I was forced to do to Sam.

facts.what: Gage 鬼使神差握住倒在 Sarah 身上、正被做心肺复苏的「死者」的手，对其耳语 Brother, you don't need air to breathe——ski mask 下的 Johnny 应声睁眼，第一句先问 Sarah 是否没事，随后人消失得无影无踪。
facts.anchor: I leaned down to his ear and simply whispered, “Brother, you don’t need air to breathe.”

facts.what: Dale 赶到后把牧师往死里揍（旁人拉阻不住）；与此同时 Finn 和 Sebastian 从牧师家中带出一个只穿沾污粉色睡裙的小女孩。
facts.anchor: Finn and Sebastian were exiting the pastor’s home with a tiny girl.

facts.what: Gage 惊叹地对 Sebastian 说「你刚救了 Blue 的妹妹」；Sarah 跪地落泪，称自己此刻能感到 Blue，并发誓守护这个小女孩。
facts.anchor: With an astonished smile, I looked to Sebastian. “You just rescued Blue’s sister.”

facts.what: 为让三人装作无事，另一名蒙面男塞给 Finn 五十美元，命令他们去麦当劳清空芝士汉堡、然后马上回家。
facts.anchor: Another man handed Finn fifty bucks. “For now, act normal. Go to McDonald’s, clean them out of cheeseburgers, then get your asses home.”

facts.what: Kristen 抚着小女孩与 Blue 一模一样的白发介绍：她真名 Hephzibah 但她不喜欢；Sarah 指着 Blue Bell 冰淇淋桶宣布她给自己选了新名字 Bluebell。
facts.anchor: “Boys, this precious angel doesn’t like her name, Hephzibah, but she looooves ice cream.”

facts.what: 深夜异响加短信惊醒 Gage 与 Ethan；Sebastian 也收到同一条短信——Kristen 发来的只有一个词：Hide!（快藏起来），三人随即去转移 Bluebell 与 Sarah。
facts.anchor: Panicked, Seb held up his phone, showing he got the same text. One very powerful word from Kristen:

facts.what: 结尾：楼下枪响与扭打归于死寂、密室镜门把手转动之际，Gage 握拳对兄弟们喊出最后一句话——给他们狠狠地还击。
facts.anchor: So, I said, “Give ’em all the hell you got, my brothers.”
